arguments.sql: SELECT c.Name, cl.Language FROM country c JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage WHERE CountryCode = c.Code);

name: execute_sql

content:
SELECT c.Name, cl.Language
FROM country c
JOIN (
  SELECT CountryCode, Language, Percentage,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Percentage DESC) AS rn
  FROM countrylanguage
) cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode AND cl.rn = 1
